start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Format is "YYYY-MM-DD". Represents the date the reporting period begins. Typically, this is the harvest date of the commodity crop from the season prior to the practice change.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Format is "YYYY-MM-DD". Represents the date the reporting period ends. Typically, this is the harvest date of the commodity crop during the practice change season, or the date of the last management event, whichever is later.

BaseReportingInformation.title: BaseReportingInformation
BaseReportingInformation.description:
The `ReportingInformation` object specifies the metadata needed to quantify emissions/removals for a field, including the time period for which emissions should be quantified, and the crop the emissions/removals will be quantified for.

Typically the `ReportingInformation` period correlates with a growing season or crop year for a field where regenerative or intervention practices are adopted.

acres.title: Area in acres
acres.description: The area of the field in acres.

reporting_information.description: An object containing information about the time period for which carbon outcomes are quantified (AKA the ‘crediting period’), the area and the crop for the field.

credit_share.title: Credit Share
credit_share.description: An emissions redistribution value that redistributes credits proportionally based on the initial (preliminary) DNDC results. This is calculated as: (preliminary tCO2e for a field/total preliminary tCO2e) * post-uncertainty tCO2e.

field_name.title: Field Name
field_name.description: The common description provided for the field.

scenarios_service_schema__public__interv.title: FieldLevelCreditShareOutcomes
scenarios_service_schema__public__interv.description: An object containing data about the reporting period and credit share for the specified field.
